text:
Hey everyone, looking for some experiences with the Ramat Gan branch. We just received our appointment for the interview, but it's in January 2027, which is frustrating. We did get an invitation for an initial meeting this July, where they'll issue a new B2 visa valid until the interview.

We're relieved they will at least extend the B2, but we want to ask for an intervisa so we can travel. Has anyone successfully managed to get an Intervisa while on a B2 during this waiting phase?

Also, any suggestions on how to ask for an earlier interview slot? Cancellations, a wait list?

My documents will be older than six months by that point. Will I need to get all of them again?

Thanks for any suggestions!
